params.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS runs,
       COUNT(DISTINCT workflow_id) AS workflows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
       COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ERROR' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 0) AS success_rate,
       CASE WHEN AVG(duration_ms) >= 1000 THEN ROUND(AVG(duration_ms) / 1000.0, 1) || ' s'
            ELSE COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)), 0) || ' ms' END AS avg_time
FROM executions
WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(duration_ms) DESC) AS rank,
       MAX(workflow_name) AS workflow,
       COUNT(*) AS runs,
       CASE WHEN AVG(duration_ms) >= 1000 THEN ROUND(AVG(duration_ms) / 1000.0, 1) || ' s'
            ELSE ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) || ' ms' END AS avg_time,
       CASE WHEN MAX(duration_ms) >= 1000 THEN ROUND(MAX(duration_ms) / 1000.0, 1) || ' s'
            ELSE MAX(duration_ms) || ' ms' END AS max_time
FROM executions
WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY workflow_id
ORDER BY AVG(duration_ms) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rank,
       MAX(workflow_name) AS workflow,
       COUNT(*) AS runs,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ERROR' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) / COUNT(*)) AS success_rate
FROM executions
WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY workflow_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY failed DESC, runs DESC
LIMIT 5
